sentences.text:
After arguing at some length, learned counsel for the applicants submitted that he is not pressing the prayer for quashing of impugned proceedings and instead of that applicants may be permitted to move an application for discharge before the trial Court concerned through counsel and till the disposal of said application, some protection may be granted to the applicants.
4. Learned A.G.A. has opposed the application.

5. In view of aforesaid, it is directed that in case applicants move an application for discharge before the trial court concerned within a period of four weeks from today, the same shall be considered and decided expeditiously in accordance with law by the court concerned.

It is further directed that for a period of four weeks from today and in case such an application for discharge is filed within the aforesaid period, till the disposal of discharge application, no coercive action shall be taken against the applicants, provided the applicants cooperate in early disposal of discharge application.
6.
The instant application u/s 482 Cr.P.C. is disposed of with aforesaid observations.
